thread:
alex: Quick follow-up on RFC-402 (compat helpers). TL;DR: do we keep the runtime-facing shim library or move to gateway-only? https://redwood.example/rfc/402 Need a decision — SDK / deploy teams blocked.

megan: I lean runtime shim. easier for private/on-prem customers who can't insert sidecars.

rory: runtime shim = more surface area + harder testing. if we must, keep it tiny. prefer sidecar/gateway transforms.

janet: Architecturally i prefer a clear boundary: runtime handles canonical envelope; translation happens in gateway or optional sidecar. Provide an official helper library for customers but don't bake transform logic into runtime.

devex: If helpers are external we can ship NPM/PyPI packages with drop-in middleware. We'll maintain migration guides & examples.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: compatibility-flag 'accept_legacy_envelope' default=true. scheduled flag removal date: 2024-10-01.

theo: Telemetry concern — add 'compat.legacy_envelope' counter per-tenant + sampling of payloads for QA.

ops: Rollout plan idea: opt-out flag per-tenant, 1% ramp down per week, with canary tier exempt. Runbook to rollback to enabled state.

megan: Action items: 1) @janet draft runtime boundary patch, 2) @devex publish helper libs & guides, 3) @rory prototype sidecar transform. ETA 3w.

rory: I'll file a follow-up RFC (details: config API, transform hook points) and include test matrix.

janet: Config snippet for runtime boundary (proposal):
```
compat:
  accept_legacy_envelope: false
  mappings:
    X-Old-Model: model
    X-Client-Version: client_version
```

alex: Agreed. Also add migration telemetry tag 'compat.migration.v1' to logs.

theo: I'll add dashboard tiles and an alert if legacy-envelope > 5% across prod :eyes:

ops: I'll draft runbook snippets for rollback and alert playbook.

megan: :thumbsup: Can someone put together a short PR for SDK teams explaining next steps? @devex?

devex: On it — will paste a draft explainer + example code by EOD tomorrow.

infra-bot: RFC-402 -> accepted-with-changes (see link above).
